IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: FRAMEWORKS PARTNERS WITH ADVOCATES, RESEARCHERS, STORYTELLERS, AND COALITIONS TO REFRAME SOCIAL ISSUES. THROUGH RIGOROUS RESEARCH ON CULTURE, COGNITION, AND COMMUNICATIONS, WE HELP BUILD FRAMING AND NARRATIVE STRATEGIES THAT DEEPEN UNDERSTANDING OF COMPLEX PROBLEMS AND CATALYZE ACTION TO MAKE OUR WORLD MORE JUST.
IRS990.MissionDesc: TO IDENTIFY, CONDUCT, TRANSLATE, AND APPLY RIGOROUS RESEARCH THAT FRAMES THE PUBLIC DISCOURSE ON SOCIAL PROBLEMS IN ORDER TO ADVANCE THE NONPROFIT AND PUBLIC SECTORS' COMMUNICATIONS CAPACITY, ALIGNMENT, AND EFFECTIVENESS.
IRS990.Desc: HEALTH: FRAMEWORKS' RESEARCH HAS TAKEN PLACE ON A WIDE VARIETY OF ISSUE AREAS, INCLUDING CHILDREN'S MENTAL AND ORAL HEALT, TOBACCO-RELATED HEALTH DISPARITIES, SOCIAL DETERMINTS OF HEALH, THE INTERSECTION OF PUBLIC HEALTH AND OTHER SECTORS, COMMUNITY HEALTH, ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH, HEALTH CARE AND PUBLIC INFORMATICS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CHILDREN YOUTH & FAMILIES: FRAMEWORKS HELPS NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS THAT SERVE CHILDREN AND FAMILIES TO DISCOVER AND DOCUMENT THE EFFECTS OF FRAMES ON PUBLIC VIEWS AND ATTITUDES, AS WELL AS TRANSLATE THE VIEWS OF EXPERTS TO THEIR RESPECTIVE PUBLICS. THE AIM OF THIS WORK IS TWO-FOLD: TO DEEPEN PUBLIC UNDERSTANDING OF COMPLEX SOCIAL PROBLEMS AND TO HELP INDIVIDUALS BETTER EVALUATE POTENTIAL SOLUTIONS TO THE TOUGH CHALLENGES THAT CONFRONT MANY CHILDREN AND THEIR FAMILIES. ISSUES ADDRESSED RANGE FROM EARLY CHILDHOOD DEVELOPMENT TO CHILD ABUSE PREVENTION, CHILD NUTRITION AND ORAL HEALTH, ADOLESCENT DEVELOPMENT, CRIMINAL JUSTICE, FOSTER CARE, AND EDUCATIONAL REFORM.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: ECONOMY AND EQUALITY: AS INCOME INEQUALITY CONTINUES TO RISE, PEOPLE ARE PAYING MORE ATTENTION TO ITS EFFECTS ON THE COUNTRY'S SOCIAL, ECONOMIC, AND POLITICAL SYSTEMS. DISCUSSIONS ABOUT WAYS TO ALLEVIATE POVERTY, REDUCE INEQUITY, PROMOTE ECONOMIC MOBILITY, AND REDEFINING THE FUTURE OF WORK ARE PERMEATING POLICY CIRCLES, THE MEDIA, AND SCHOLARLY PUBLICATIONS AND FRAMEWORKS IS ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN RESEARCH IN ALL THESE AREAS.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: CROSS-CUTTING: WORK IN THIS AREA, ALONG WITH THAT UNDERWRITTEN BY GENERAL SUPPORT, FOCUS ON INTELLECTUAL INQUIRY AND SERVICES THAT CROSS DISCRETE ISSUE-FOCUSED BOUNDARIES AND ARE WIDE-RANGING IN IMPACT.

HUMAN RIGHTS, SERVICES AND JUSTICE: FRAMEWORKS UNDERTAKES MULTIPLE PROJECTS IN THE AREAS OF HUMAN RIGHTS, SERVICES, AND JUSTICE. RESEARCHERS STUDY HOW NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS CAN HELP THE PUBLIC UNDERSTAND THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM AND THE NEED TO REFORM IT IN THE U.S. AND THE UNITED KINGDOM. THE INSTITUTE ALSO EXPLORED HOW ADVOCATES IN JACKSONVILLE, FLORIDA, CAN MOBILIZE THEIR COMMUNITY AROUND IMPROVING OUTCOMES FOR CHILDREN AND YOUTH. ADDITIONALLY, THE INSTITUTE HAS CONDUCTED RESEARCH IN THE U.S. AND THE UNITED KINGDOM ON AFFORDABLE HOUSING.

PUBLICATIONS AND CURRICULA: FRAMEWORKS ACADEMY IS FRAMEWORKS' ONLINE LEARNING PLATFORM THAT CONTAINS MULTIMEDIA CLASSES ON FRAMING AND ITS APPLICATIONS IN A VARIETY OF AREAS. AMONG ITS MANY OFFERINGS ARE COURSES ON FRAMING SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, AND MATH (STEM) EDUCATION, REFRAMING ELDER ABUSE AND FRAMING FOR CLIMATE INTERPRETERS.

EDUCATION: RECOGNIZING THE CHALLENGE THAT NONPROFIT AND PUBLIC-SECTOR LEADERS FACE IN ENGAGING THE AMERICAN PUBLIC IN MEANINGFUL EDUCATION REFORMS, AN INFLUENTIAL GROUP OF PHILANTHROPIC LEADERS CAME TOGETHER TO PARTNER WITH THE INSTITUTE IN DEVELOPING EFFECTIVE NEW WAYS OF TALKING ABOUT THIS CRITICAL ISSUE: A NEW CORE STORY OF EDUCATION. FRAMEWORKS OFFERS WORKSHOPS AND ON- LINE COURSES TO HELP ADVOCATES USE THIS RESEARCH. FRAMEWORKS ALSO WORKS WITH THE PARTNERSHIP FOR THE FUTURE OF LEARNING IN THE SHARED STORY PROJECT, A COLLABORATIVE EFFORT TO CREATE A NARRATIVE SHIFT THAT CENTERS PUBLIC EDUCATION AS A PUBLIC GOOD. ADDITIONALLY, FRAMEWORKS HAS CONDUCTED RESEARCH ON FAMILY, SCHOOL AND COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT IN EARLY CHILDHOOD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 1A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD, BY RESOLUTION ADOPTED BY A MAJORITY OF THE ENTIRE BOARD, MAY DESIGNATE FROM AMONG THE DIRECTORS AN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE AND OTHER COMMITTEES OF THE BOARD CONSISTING OF THREE (3) OR MORE DIRECTORS. EACH COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD SHALL HAVE SUCH AUTHORITY AS THE BOARD SHALL BY RESOLUTION PROVIDE; AND THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL HAVE ALL THE AUTHORITY OF THE BOARD, EXCEPT THAT NO SUCH COMMITTEE SHALL HAVE THE ABILITY TO ADDRESS THOSE MATTERS PROHIBITED TO BE ADDRESSED BY THE FULL BOARD UNDER APPLICABLE STATE LAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS PREPARED BY MANAGEMENT AND REVIEWED IN DETAIL BY THE FINANCE COMMITTEE. A COMPLETE COPY IS PROVIDED TO THE FULL BOARD OF DIRECTORS PRIOR TO FILING, AND QUESTIONS ARE ADDRESSED BEFORE SUBMISSION WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FRAMEWORKS REGULARLY AND CONSISTENTLY MONITORS ENFORCEMENT OF ITS CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY THROUGH ANNUAL DISCLOSURE STATEMENTS COMPLETED BY ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND STAFF, ALONG WITH ONGOING REVIEW BY LEADERSHIP AND THE BOARD. DISCLOSURES ARE REVIEWED FOR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS, AND ANY IDENTIFIED CONFLICTS ARE DOCUMENTED AND MANAGED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE POLICY, INCLUDING RECUSAL FROM DISCUSSIONS AND DECISION MAKING WHEN APPROPRIATE. THE POLICY IS REVISITED PERIODICALLY TO ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE AND ALIGNMENT WITH BEST PRACTICES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION OF THE PRESIDENT AND CEO IS SET BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS ON AN ANNUAL BASIS FOLLOWING THE REVIEW OF JOB PERFORMANCE OVER THE PRIOR YEAR. A PERFORMANCE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD USES MARKET DATA FOR COMPARABLY SIZED AND LOCATED ORGANIZATIONS AGAINST WHICH THE CEO'S COMPENSATION IS BENCHMARKED AS THE BASIS FOR THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. THE PERFORMANCE COMMITTEE LIKEWISE REVIEWS AND RECOMMENDS TO THE BOARD THE SALARIES OF KEY EMPLOYEES AGAINST BENCHMARK MARKET DATA FOR COMPARABLY SIZED AND LOCATED ORGANIZATIONS. THE PROCESS DESCRIBED HERE WAS LAST COMPLETED IN 2025.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19 FRAMEWORK MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
